shots.title: Orb Presence
shots.prompt: A restrained cinematic close portrait in Midgar: Yuffie in her Moogle cape calmly presents a hovering green materia orb above her raised finger. The world breathes through subtle industrial haze and distant light, while her identity and expression remain stable.
